title: A Representation-Theoretic Framework for Characterizing Barren Plateaus
summary: The scalability of variational quantum algorithms is fundamentally limited by the barren plateau effect, where the cost-function variance vanishes with system size, rendering optimization impractical. Recent Lie-algebraic approaches for deep parameterized have enabled a unified analytical understanding of this challenge but require either the initial state or the measurement observable to belong to the dynamical Lie algebra generated by the circuit.
